_doc: No Justice, step 4 (#843's plan, #966): the cabin, the knife and the nod. The lines are docs/scripts/no_justice.json's scene cabin (barred, surrender, not_only, knife, bargain, ask, unclear, nod, thanks, done, murder), its back scene's arrest lines (back.kett, back.joe_kett) on the walk to the jail, and the fight's mine (fight.mine), said as written there (status new or bible, all PROPOSED). From the hideout's end (step 3, NoJusticeHideout: nojustice.kett = holed_up, Kett barred in the line shack; down_outside, alive in the dirt, plays from the surrender where he lies; dead_outside or dead_inside is the `outside` ending at once). The first prompt says the next thing is the door. Near it Kett bluffs (cabin.barred). You force it: kicks (hold E) on the door add up (a barred door takes `bar_kicks` sound standing kicks, each counted by its speed against a sound one's, squared, up to `kick_most` on the run: three standing, two on the run; unbarred, `door_kicks`: one; a leg already hurt counts less, by the same amount every time; the door takes the kick, not your foot, #1111), and a kick on the shack's other walls says where the door is, or a ball through the bar, or any way in through the wall's members; no dynamite (Sean, 2026-11-09). In: Kett unarmed, hands up, backing into the far corner (cabin.surrender), Joe in behind you (cabin.not_only), Joe's knife drawn (in his hand only; his gun holstered) and to the man (cabin.knife), the bargain, Joe turns to you: 'Are you going to stop me?' (cabin.ask). You answer with your head (HeadGesture, as the camp's ask): a nod stops him (cabin.nod, he puts the knife away; cabin.thanks; then you arrest him, G by him: he's given up, an OutlawBrain SURRENDERED with nothing to say but the script's); a shake lets him (the revenge, on the wound system: his knife by HumanBody.take_knife, the camera never moving in; cabin.done once Kett's down); a small or slow nod (the loose reading only) gets 'Is that a yes?' and he waits again. Acting answers too: stepping between them, drawing on Joe or on Kett (you take him at your gun), a shove at Joe, or binding Kett (G by him: he's given up from his surrender on) is a nod; walking out of the shack is a shake; saying nothing for `answer_s` and he does it (MISSIONS.md beat 33; standing still while Joe walks round you isn't stepping between them: you must move into his way, #1111). Shooting the man who's given up (any time after his surrender) is the murder: 'He had his hands up.' if Joe saw it. Endings (StoryState nojustice.ending): arrest / revenge / murder / outside; also nojustice.joe_trust, nojustice.camp_trust, nojustice.answer (nod, shake, between, drew_on_joe, drew_on_kett, walked_out, none), nojustice.joe_saw (the murder), nojustice.bodies (left, on revenge or murder). The way back: an arrest's ride to town is a card (riding isn't built, #478), then Kett walks bound behind you to the jail's door (the valley's jail, #811; inside to the cells is a card: the stand-in); on revenge the bodies are left at the hideout. Started from the hideout's end, by `-- --world=valley --mission=no_justice_cabin [--down]` or the bridge's `moment no_justice_cabin set_up=1 [kett=down_outside]` (the hideout set up and over, its crew dead, Kett barred in).
status: PROPOSED (#966): the beats' timings, what acting answers mean (drawing on Kett is an arrest), the trust words and the stand-ins are this session's. Stand-ins: the knife is two boxes in Joe's hand (no knife model yet: the prop lab's); Joe's stab is the 'aim' pose's arm out; the jail's inside and cells are a card.
_local: Points in the shack's own space [x, z]: x 0..width (4.2) along its front, z 0..depth (5.0) back from the front wall; the door in the middle of the front (x 2.1).
aid_doc: #1116 (Sean): Joe down, your first aid gets him up: E held (past a tap) within aid_reach_m of his wound for aid_s binds every wound and splints a leg that won't hold him (Physiology.bind_up); he limps in himself and the knife and the ask wait for him. The game says so within aid_told_m, every aid_told_every_s.

loose._doc: The small or slow nod: HeadGesture with these (the plain one is 6 degrees, 1.4 s).

stab._doc: Joe's knife: stabs into the chest and belly (`depth` m of blade), `every_s` apart, then a slash across the neck; on till Kett's down or `most` cuts.

jail._doc: The arrest's way back: the card's metres from the shack to the jail at a horse's walk; then you on Main Street this far in front of the jail's door (its own space: x east from the west front corner, z south; the door at x 5.49 on the front wall), Kett and Joe by you; Kett at the door with you is jailed (the cells are a card).
